NAIROBI
Dear Madam,
RE: CLAIM NO. STI/CLM/2024/3318 - FIRE AT INDUSTRIAL AREA PREMISES ON 3RD AUGUST 2024
We refer to the above claim. Our records show that written notice of the loss was received on 12th August 2024, nine days after the loss. Clause 6.2 of the policy requires written notice within 7 days.
In addition, our investigations indicate an electrical fault at the premises that was not disclosed at the time of the proposal.
For these reasons we regret that we are unable to admit liability under the policy. This letter is written without prejudice to any other rights of the operator.
Yours faithfully,
____________________
Head of Claims
